takeaways: Speaking is far faster than typing, so a real-time voice interface removes the biggest bottleneck between users and Copilot.
Grounding a real-time GPT-4o voice model in Azure AI Search through a RAG pattern and a middle-tier proxy keeps answers factual, permission-scoped and auditable.
Let Copilot Studio or Power Apps handle the voice front end while Azure carries the heavy workload, so Power Platform request limits and governance rules are respected.
hook: You speak far faster than you type, yet most people still query Copilot with their thumbs. This episode shows architects and makers how to build a secure, voice-driven knowledge layer with the GPT-4o real-time API, Azure AI Search and Power Platform, without breaking compliance.
